top_signals.title: Asset Purchase Facility: Gilt Sales – Market Notice 17 September 2026
top_signals.summary: This Market Notice outlines the Bank Executive’s approach to implementing the Monetary Policy Committee’s (MPC) decision to unwind the gilts held for monetary policy purposes in the Asset Purchase Facility (APF). As part of this, Bank APF auctions will be paused while the Bank reviews a model of selling gilts to the Government.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Animoca puts Currenc merger on ice, delaying its Nasdaq debut
top_signals.summary: Animoca Brands suspended its reverse merger talks with Currenc but said it remains committed to pursuing a listing on a major exchange.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.
